data.body: Investigation (2026-05-12): acli-integration.py _LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA mapping correctly maps 'in_progress' → 'In Progress' (line 54). Transition code at line 383 uses this mapping. Code is correct. Possible causes: (1) Jira workflow does not have 'In Progress' transition configured, (2) tickets missing SYNC event (not created in Jira first), (3) ACLI transition command failing silently. Recommend checking BRIDGE_ALERT events on affected in_progress tickets and verifying Jira workflow transitions.
